Home.subtitle: An intelligent bioinformatics analysis platform powered by visual node workflows
Home.desc1: BioFlow AI is a next-generation platform for bioinformatics researchers. Through an intuitive <highlight>visual node editor</highlight>, complex analysis pipelines are decomposed into reusable modules — drag-and-drop to build RNA-seq, WGS, single-cell, and more.
Home.desc2: The platform comes with a built-in <highlight>AI agent</highlight> that understands natural-language instructions, automatically plans analysis steps, assists with parameter tuning and result interpretation — making bioinformatics smarter and faster.
Home.footer: © {year} BioFlow AI. Built for bioinformatics researchers.
